The intersection of Layton and Howell Avenues has been on the City of Milwaukee's number one accident intersection listing since 1971. With an average of 39 accidents per year or a total of 117 accidents only 11 of them involved trucks.
The following 1973 accident summary for Milwaukee County gives an indication that removing traffic from the local arterial system and putting it on the freeway system will reduce accidents significantly.
